bibl.title: Episcopal Networks and Authority in Late Antique Egypt. Bishops of the Theban Region at Work
bibl.seg: Renate Dekker, Episcopal Networks and Authority in Late Antique Egypt. Bishops of the Theban Region at Work = Orientalia Lovaniensia Analecta. 264.
Leuven - Paris - Bristol, CT, Peeters, 2018, xvi-350 pp., figg., 1 CD-ROM. ISBN 978-90-429-3560-0. €96.

C.R. par Ariel López, BMCRev < http://bmcr.brynmawr.edu/2019/2019-05-24.html >. - Giovanni Ruffini, BASP 56 (2019) pp. 360-366. - Élodie Mazy, ChrEg 94 (2019) No. 188, pp. 443-445. - Deborah Decru, Bulletin de la Société d'Archéologie copte 57 (2018) pp. 305-307.
bibl.note: Corrected version of a PhD dissertation (Leiden, November 7, 2017). - General introduction. - Chapter 1: The analysis of episcopal networks and authority. - Chapter 2: The Theban region. - Chapter 3: The Theodosian network in the Theban region. - Chapter 4: The social network of the Theban region. - Chapter 5: The social network of Abraham of Hermonthis. - Chapter 6: The nature of Abraham's authority. - Chapter 7: The social network of Pesynthius of Koptos. - Chapter 8: The nature of Pesynthius' authority. - General conclusions. - Bibliography. Maps, lists, plates, and tables. Indices.
